translations.en: And he, peace be upon him, forbade that the saddle be ridden with a gap.

en.summary: This hadith reports a prohibition from the Imam عليه السلام regarding riding on a saddle that has a gap. It indicates a practical legal and ethical ruling related to proper riding equipment and avoiding an unsuitable or defective saddle.
en.seo_question: What is the ruling on riding with a saddle that has a gap?

key_terms.يُرْكَبَ: to be ridden; refers to the act of riding
key_terms.بِفَرْجٍ: with a gap or opening in it
